scope: Read-only review of the complete product-source diff, with extra attention to general geometry grounding and obligation retention. No source changes, new test runs, real model calls, HTTP retrievals or ORCA starts during this final review.
reviewer_role: Contributor to input-role, identity-name, knowledge-archive and context-effect fixes; reviewer of the independently authored semantic and native-reservation changes. This is not a claim that all reviewed changes had an independent author-reviewer pair.
conclusion: No blocking correctness finding identified for freezing this candidate and executing the authorized same-seven-task single-repetition rerun.

facts: General geometry context is tied to authenticated quantity occurrences and preceding standalone geometry directives. Explicit initial XYZ/hash restrictions are checked before derived-geometry scalar omission.

When one scalar geometry relation is inapplicable, geometry/independent-calculation clauses must remain contiguous authenticated text in text_basis or minimum_evidence. The validator returns corrections instead of rewriting the proposal.
The general Goal remains generic-observation-1 with reported-with-limitations unless explicit qualification is required; specialized checker and execution paths are unchanged.

General electronic-energy coverage requires the requested quantity at an authenticated occurrence in the obligation, required Goal/target binding, and the same general geometry rule. A port label or another clause does not substitute.
Direct native workload reservation compares admission_version with the immutable Run policy profile contract, while retaining unstarted Attempt, policy equality and input-hash checks.
Input roles and reference ports come from the existing Tool definition and fail before Plan activation.
Trailing molecular formula separation retains the original name and requires graph element agreement plus existing exact name/same-CID evidence; unresolved aliases publish no qualified output.
Knowledge archival reuses the same single bounded retrieval bytes before text decoding and imports through existing Artifact quotas.
Quota failure remains an unsuccessful operation with retained raw Call evidence; answer/selection consumers reject the failed source.
archive_retrieved_evidence is synchronized in context.py and context_efficiency.py read-effect classification; it is not permission for task-file generation or computation.
Nested archive URL restoration requires equality with the already-approved document URL; unrelated paths retain generic redaction.

validation_evidence_reviewed.note: Read existing root evidence; this reviewer did not rerun the complete suite during final review.

limitations: The geometry parser is a finite lexical source-grounding rule, not a proof of arbitrary natural-language semantics. Exact user constraints remain required review evidence in actual runs.

The mixed-source 53-file run and interrupted complete unit/integration run are development diagnostics, not a green complete-suite claim. Four historical 12K context capacity failures remain; 64K same-fact probes are separate evidence.
This review does not establish real model behavior, ORCA success, scientific correctness or completion of the broader step-7 reference/control/repetition requirements.
